description: This file defines the IoTFleetHubClient class used to interact with the AWS IoT Fleet Hub service. It mainly provides method annotations for various operations like create, delete, describe, list, tag, untag, and update applications related to IoT Fleet Hub.

classes.name: IoTFleetHubClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS IoT Fleet Hub service, extending AwsClient, providing methods to manage IoT applications.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes an existing IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: describeApplication
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific IoT Fleet Hub application.

methods.name: listApplications
methods.description: Lists all IoT Fleet Hub applications.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: updateApplication
methods.description: Updates an existing IoT Fleet Hub application.
